sn17.8:1.3: Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayaṃ siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || ||
sn17.8:1.5: Eso kho bhikkhave jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena puṭṭho neva suññāgāragato ramati || na rukkhamūlagato ramati na ajjhokāsagato ramati ||
sn17.8:1.6: yena yena gacchati yattha yattha tiṭṭhati yattha yattha nisīdati yattha nipajjati tattha tattha anayavyasanam āpajjati || || 5
sn17.8:1.7: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto neva suññāgāragato ramati || na rukkhamūlagato ramati na ajjhokāsagato ramati ||
